# Research proposal: descriptive title

Status: PROPOSED. Exploratory or confirmatory: specify.
Public issue: specify. Author/contributors: specify. Budget approval: specify or none.

## Question and falsification

State the mechanism, null hypothesis, competing explanation and outcome that would
falsify the claim. Name one bounded decision this experiment informs.

## Universe, units and baseline

Specify instruments/geography, currency, sampling frequency, horizon, benchmark,
metric definition and threshold. Distinguish price changes from total returns.

## Data contract and rights

Name source and terms URLs, retrieval method, observation coverage, vintage,
availability/release times, hashing, missing-value policy, FX and corporate-action
handling. State what may be shared and what remains local.

## Frozen evaluation plan

Specify train/validation/untouched-test boundaries, parameter search space, trial
accounting, costs, perturbations, dependence/overlap handling and stop conditions.
Record the freeze commit before confirmatory evaluation. Disclose previously viewed
results. A later change needs a new version and a new trial record.

## Reproduction and resources

List intended commands, environment, seed policy, runtime/storage constraints and
whether any network access or paid resource is required. No approval is implied.

## Limitations and review

List foreseeable bias and missing evidence. Identify the review needed before the
work can support stronger conclusions. No trading or promotion is requested here.
